eyebrow: What actually counts as PII here
code:
Obviously sensitive:   name, phone number, payment card details
Less obviously so:     precise pickup/dropoff coordinates --
                       can reveal home and work, no name needed
caption: The sharpest edge case in this course's own data.

code:
Classification:  tag a field as sensitive in Purview's catalog
Access control:  restrict who can query the unmasked column
Masking:         RawTripEvents
                 | extend Masked = strcat(substring(tostring(PickupLat),0,2), "...")
caption: Together, an aggregated view for everyone, exact coordinates for a narrow audited group.
